<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Wing Bounce](/Feats.aspx?ID=5530) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 82

**Archetype** [Winged Warrior](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=227)

**Prerequisites**
[Winged Warrior Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5527)

</column>

---

You rush forward, flapping your wings for a bit of lift, and can use that momentum to knock down a foe. [Leap](/Actions.aspx?ID=2298), and if you land within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can attempt to [Trip](/Actions.aspx?ID=2382) that enemy. You don't need to have one hand free. If you successfully knock the target [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88), you can Leap again. If you have a fly Speed, you can [Fly](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312) instead of Leap.
name: Wing Bounce
